example_en: Compared to last year, prices have risen sharply.

meaning_ko: 무엇이 중요하고 관련 있는지에 대한 관념, 관련성에 대한 나름의 기준
example_en: Every editor works from a personal conception of relevance.

meaning_ko: 확증 편향(자신의 믿음에 맞는 정보만 받아들이고 반대되는 증거는 피하는 경향)
example_en: Confirmation bias makes us ignore evidence that challenges our beliefs.
The border region has long been conflict-prone.

meaning_ko: 연결주의의(지식이 신경망 같은 연결 패턴으로 저장된다고 보는)
example_en: Connectionist models describe learning as a change in network connections.

meaning_ko: 소비·소모될 수 있는, 곧바로 써 없앨 수 있는; 소모품
example_en: The shop stocks consumable goods such as paper and ink.

meaning_ko: 등고선(지도에서 높이가 같은 지점을 이은 선)
example_en: Contour lines on the map show how steep the hill is.

meaning_ko: 통념, 사람들이 흔히 옳다고 여기는 생각
example_en: Conventional wisdom says that breakfast is the most important meal.
The number on your ticket corresponds to your seat.

meaning_ko: 비용 대비 효과가 큰, 들인 돈만큼 값어치를 하는
example_en: Replacing the old boiler proved cost effective within two years.
Her lawyer counselled against signing the contract.
Decontextualized facts are much harder to remember.
The city painted dedicated bike lanes along the river.
The charity is dedicated to helping homeless teenagers.

meaning_ko: 이길 수 있는, 물리칠 수 있는
example_en: By the final round the champion looked tired and defeatable.

meaning_ko: 방어 기제(위협에 맞서 자신을 보호하려는 반응)
example_en: Humor can be a defense mechanism against stress.

meaning_ko: 비물질화(제품이 물리적 실체를 덜 쓰거나 서비스로 대체되는 현상)
example_en: Streaming music is a familiar example of dematerialization.

meaning_ko: 차등 대우(사정이 다른 사람을 다르게 대하는 것)
example_en: Students with disabilities may need differential treatment to compete fairly.

meaning_ko: 방향 감각을 잃게 하다, 혼란스럽게 하다
example_en: The thick fog disoriented the hikers within minutes.

meaning_ko: 분배 정의(사회의 부와 부담을 어떻게 나눌 것인가에 관한 정의)
example_en: Debates about taxes are really debates about distributive justice.
She completed her doctoral degree in five years.

meaning_ko: 극적인 변화, 눈에 띄게 큰 변화
example_en: The village has seen dramatic changes since the factory opened.
He was drawn into an argument he never wanted.
Water temperature strongly affects the drinkability of green tea.
The temperature dropped below zero overnight.

meaning_ko: 정서적 애착(어떤 대상에 마음이 붙는 것)
example_en: Children form strong emotional attachments to their toys.
The entrance fee for students is half price.
Investors compare the expected returns of each fund.
Her playing is admired for its warmth and expressivity.

meaning_ko: 외재화(문제를 자신과 분리해 바깥의 것처럼 다루기), 외부화
example_en: Externalization helps clients see the problem as separate from themselves.

meaning_ko: (면이) 위를 향한 채; (face up to 로) ~을 직시하다
example_en: Place the card on the table facing up.
Forgetting his name was an embarrassing faux pas.
She filed away the receipts in a labeled box.
He applied to film school right after graduating.
Tickets are cheaper on the final day of the festival.
The report offers a fine-grained analysis of the survey results.
The lost bird kept calling until its flockmates answered.
You can download the app for free.
Some birds, for instance penguins, cannot fly.
The house next door is for sale.

meaning_ko: 강제 원근법(거리감을 조작해 사물을 실제보다 크거나 작게 보이게 하는 기법)
example_en: Forced perspective makes the tiny model look like a real building.
The former champion returned to the ring after five years.

meaning_ko: 화석화(생물의 흔적이 화석으로 남게 되는 과정)
example_en: Fossilization usually requires rapid burial in sediment.
Delivery is free of charge on orders over fifty dollars.
Make sure your phone is fully charged before the trip.

meaning_ko: 일반 입장(권), 지정석 없는 기본 입장료
example_en: General admission does not include a reserved seat.

meaning_ko: 조금밖에 쓰지 않아 상태가 좋은, 거의 새것 같은 중고의
example_en: The shop resells gently-used winter coats.
Natural gas lies geologically trapped beneath layers of rock.

meaning_ko: 자기 생각(요점)을 남에게 이해시키다, 뜻을 제대로 전달하다
example_en: He used simple drawings to get his point across.

meaning_ko: 포기하다, 단념하다; (기계가) 작동을 멈추다, 숨을 거두다
example_en: After three repairs, the old printer finally gave up the ghost.
We are going for a swim before breakfast.

meaning_ko: 골드 플레이팅(요구되지도 않은 기능을 불필요하게 덧붙여 비용만 올리는 일), 금도금
example_en: Gold plating adds cost to a project without adding value.
Fairness is one of the governing principles of the law.
I prefer the hallway side so I can stretch my legs.

meaning_ko: 마지막 말을 하다(논쟁을 자기 말로 끝내다), 최종 결정권을 갖다
example_en: She always has to have the last word in an argument.

meaning_ko: (보낸 연락에 대해) 답을 받았다, 회신을 받았다
example_en: I finally heard back from the company yesterday.
In the village, grazing land was held in common.

meaning_ko: (수치·수준을) 억누르다, 낮게 유지하다; 꽉 누르다; (일자리를) 유지하다
example_en: The company tried to hold down wages during the recession.

meaning_ko: 선회 대기(비행기가 착륙을 기다리며 같은 자리를 도는 것), 제자리걸음 상태
example_en: The plane stayed in a holding pattern for twenty minutes.

meaning_ko: 속이 텅 비게 된, 알맹이가 빠진; 속을 파낸
example_en: Cheap imports hollowed out the town's manufacturing base.
